description: Source code for RRC Reestablishment Procedure handling in a 5G NR UE implementation, including fallback to RRC Setup, security verification, context transfer, and message exchange.

classes.name: rrc_reestablishment_procedure
classes.description: Handles the RRC reestablishment process, including context transfer, security checks, message exchange, and fallback procedures.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine executing the reestablishment procedure steps.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reestablishment_fallback
methods.description: Handles fallback to RRC Setup if reestablishment is rejected.

methods.name: is_reestablishment_accepted
methods.description: Checks if the reestablishment request can be accepted based on context and security.

methods.name: verify_security_context
methods.description: Verifies the security context using Short MAC.

methods.name: transfer_reestablishment_context_and_update_keys
methods.description: Transfers UE context and updates security keys.

methods.name: create_srb1
methods.description: Creates and activates SRB1 for the reestablished UE.

methods.name: send_rrc_reestablishment
methods.description: Sends RRC Reestablishment message to UE.

methods.name: log_rejected_reestablishment
methods.description: Logs reasons for rejecting reestablishment and fallback.
